paragraphs: On Tuesday, November third, Pat sat in the garden of the white house at four o'clock. He had a big blank poster on his knees. The poster was for school on Friday, and the title was "My Hobby." But Pat had no hobby. His older sister May sat on the bench with Lily and Mia. Bill, the green parrot, watched them from his cage on the veranda. "What do you enjoy doing?" asked Pat. "Please tell me, because I need an idea."

"I enjoy singing," said May, "and a girl in my class is a dancer." "She loves hip hop." "I like drawing and doing puzzles, but I am not good at dancing," said Lily. "I enjoy taking photos of animals," said Mia, "and I collect animal stickers, too." Pat stood up and tried singing. His voice was very loud, and Bill shouted, "Good morning!" May clapped, but Lily and Mia laughed. "It is four o'clock, Bill!" said Pat. "Singing is too loud for this garden."

Next, Pat drew a horse, but it looked like a dog. "It is a very nice dog," said Mia. "It is a horse!" said Pat. May gave him a small drum. "A drum is an instrument," she said. "Are you interested in music?" Pat put the drum down and said, "I prefer a hobby where I can run and jump." Then he saw a box under the veranda. Inside were his old roller skates, a helmet, and knee pads. He put them on and rolled slowly along the garden path. "Skating is fun," he said. "I am a beginner, but I will practice." "If you practice every day, you will be good," said Lily. Pat wrote "MY HOBBY: SKATING" on the poster and drew a roller skate. He held it up, and the girls clapped.

Pat skated to the gate and back. This time he did not hold the bench. "You are not a beginner now," said May. "I am still a beginner," said Pat. "But I will practice every day." Mia took a photo of him for the corner of the poster. "Skating is popular at school," she said. "Many children will like your poster."
Bill looked at the poster and shouted, "Good morning!" again. "It is five o'clock, Bill," said Pat, and he laughed. "But thank you, because now I have a hobby." Which hobby do you like best?
